about: English caption and description strings the how-to publisher uses, and their translations per website locale (key = the exact English string). Use each language's own MailVault UI words from src/i18n/locales/<app code>.json.
strings: Progress runs in the corner of the window.
Operation Complete, and the Server count drops.
The Vault view still holds the archived emails.
The Server view no longer lists them.
Open the Server view of the account.
Bulk Email Operations lists the years.
Pick a year and see how many emails it selects.
Choose the action.
The option explains what it will do before you start.
Read the confirmation, then confirm.
Open Settings.
Archive & delete holds both jobs.
Tick the folders to clear.
Choose the years.
Choose when and how to delete.
The summary shows what will be removed.
Tick the confirmation and Start.
The job starts and runs in the background.
The progress panel follows the job.
The job finishes.
Archive and delete from the server for selected emails
Archive, back up and delete from the server for selected emails
Archive and delete from the server for a whole account in Settings
Archive, back up and delete from the server for a whole account in Settings
The wait is shortened here.

de.Progress runs in the corner of the windo: Der Fortschritt läuft in der Fensterecke.
de.Operation Complete, and the Server count: Vorgang abgeschlossen, und die Server-Anzahl sinkt.
de.The Vault view still holds the archived: Die Ansicht Vault enthält die archivierten E-Mails weiterhin.
Die Ansicht Server listet sie nicht mehr auf.
Öffne die Ansicht Server des Kontos.
Massenaktionen für E-Mails listet die Jahre auf.
de.Pick a year and see how many emails it s: Wähle ein Jahr und sieh, wie viele E-Mails es auswählt.
de.The option explains what it will do befo: Die Option erklärt, was sie tut, bevor du startest.
Lies die Bestätigung und bestätige dann.
Hake die Ordner an, die geleert werden sollen.
Wähle, wann und wie gelöscht wird.
Die Zusammenfassung zeigt, was entfernt wird.
Hake die Bestätigung an und drücke Starten.
de.The job starts and runs in the backgroun: Der Auftrag startet und läuft im Hintergrund.
de.Archive and delete from the server for s: Ausgewählte E-Mails archivieren und vom Server löschen
de.Archive, back up and delete from the ser: Ausgewählte E-Mails archivieren, sichern und vom Server löschen
de.Archive and delete from the server for a: Ein ganzes Konto in den Einstellungen archivieren und vom Server löschen
de.Archive, back up and delete from the ser: Ein ganzes Konto in den Einstellungen archivieren, sichern und vom Server löschen

fr.Progress runs in the corner of the windo: La progression s'affiche dans le coin de la fenêtre.
fr.Operation Complete, and the Server count: Opération terminée, et le nombre d'e-mails du serveur baisse.
fr.The Vault view still holds the archived: La vue Coffre contient toujours les e-mails archivés.
La vue Serveur ne les liste plus.
Ouvrez la vue Serveur du compte.
Opérations groupées sur les e-mails liste les années.
fr.Pick a year and see how many emails it s: Sélectionnez une année et voyez combien d'e-mails elle sélectionne.
fr.The option explains what it will do befo: L'option explique ce qu'elle va faire avant que vous démarriez.
L'onglet Archiver et supprimer contient les deux tâches.
Le récapitulatif montre ce qui sera retiré.
Cochez la confirmation et appuyez sur Démarrer.
fr.The job starts and runs in the backgroun: La tâche démarre et s'exécute en arrière-plan.
Le panneau de progression suit la tâche.
fr.Archive and delete from the server for s: Archiver et supprimer du serveur pour des e-mails sélectionnés
fr.Archive, back up and delete from the ser: Archiver, sauvegarder et supprimer du serveur pour des e-mails sélectionnés
fr.Archive and delete from the server for a: Archiver et supprimer du serveur pour un compte entier dans les Paramètres
fr.Archive, back up and delete from the ser: Archiver, sauvegarder et supprimer du serveur pour un compte entier dans les Paramètres

es.Progress runs in the corner of the windo: El progreso aparece en la esquina de la ventana.
es.Operation Complete, and the Server count: Operación completada, y el recuento de Servidor baja.
es.The Vault view still holds the archived: La vista Bóveda conserva los correos archivados.
La vista Servidor ya no los muestra.
Abre la vista Servidor de la cuenta.
Operaciones masivas de correo muestra los años.
es.Pick a year and see how many emails it s: Marca un año y mira cuántos correos selecciona.
es.The option explains what it will do befo: La opción explica lo que hará antes de que empieces.
Archivar y eliminar reúne las dos tareas.
Marca las carpetas que quieres limpiar.
El resumen muestra lo que se va a quitar.
es.The job starts and runs in the backgroun: La tarea empieza y se ejecuta en segundo plano.
El panel de progreso sigue la tarea.
es.Archive and delete from the server for s: Archivar y eliminar del servidor los correos seleccionados
es.Archive, back up and delete from the ser: Archivar, respaldar y eliminar del servidor los correos seleccionados
es.Archive and delete from the server for a: Archivar y eliminar del servidor una cuenta entera en Ajustes
es.Archive, back up and delete from the ser: Archivar, respaldar y eliminar del servidor una cuenta entera en Ajustes

it.Operation Complete, and the Server count: Operazione completata, e il conteggio del Server scende.
it.The Vault view still holds the archived: La vista Cassaforte conserva ancora le email archiviate.
La vista Server non le elenca più.
Operazioni email in blocco elenca gli anni.
it.Pick a year and see how many emails it s: Seleziona un anno e guarda quante email seleziona.
it.The option explains what it will do befo: L'opzione spiega cosa farà prima che tu inizi.
Archivia ed elimina contiene entrambe le attività.
Il riepilogo mostra cosa verrà rimosso.
Spunta la conferma e premi Avvia.
it.The job starts and runs in the backgroun: L'attività parte e prosegue in background.
Il pannello di avanzamento segue l'attività.
it.Archive and delete from the server for s: Archivia ed elimina dal server le email selezionate
it.Archive, back up and delete from the ser: Archivia, esegui il backup ed elimina dal server le email selezionate
it.Archive and delete from the server for a: Archivia ed elimina dal server un intero account nelle Impostazioni
it.Archive, back up and delete from the ser: Archivia, esegui il backup ed elimina dal server un intero account nelle Impostazioni

ja.Progress runs in the corner of the windo: 進行状況はウィンドウの隅に表示されます。
ja.Operation Complete, and the Server count: 操作が完了しました。サーバーの件数が減ります。
ja.The Vault view still holds the archived: 保管庫ビューには、アーカイブしたメールがそのまま残っています。
サーバービューには、もう表示されません。
アカウントのサーバービューを開きます。
メールの一括操作に、年が一覧表示されます。
ja.Pick a year and see how many emails it s: 年を選ぶと、対象になるメールの通数が表示されます。
ja.The option explains what it will do befo: 開始する前に、選んだ操作の内容が説明されます。
確認の内容を読んでから、確定します。
「アーカイブして削除」に、2つのジョブがあります。
削除するフォルダにチェックを入れます。
削除するタイミングと方法を選びます。
概要に、削除される内容が表示されます。
確認にチェックを入れて、開始を押します。
ja.The job starts and runs in the backgroun: ジョブが始まり、バックグラウンドで実行されます。
進行状況パネルでジョブの進行を見守れます。
ja.Archive and delete from the server for s: 選択したメールをアーカイブしてサーバーから削除
ja.Archive, back up and delete from the ser: 選択したメールをアーカイブ・バックアップしてサーバーから削除
ja.Archive and delete from the server for a: 設定からアカウント全体をアーカイブしてサーバーから削除
ja.Archive, back up and delete from the ser: 設定からアカウント全体をアーカイブ、バックアップしてサーバーから削除
待ち時間は、ここでは短縮しています。

ko.Operation Complete, and the Server count: 작업 완료, 그리고 서버의 이메일 수가 줄어듭니다.
ko.The Vault view still holds the archived: 보관함 보기에는 보관된 이메일이 그대로 있습니다.
서버 보기에는 더 이상 표시되지 않습니다.
ko.Pick a year and see how many emails it s: 연도를 고르면 선택되는 이메일 수가 표시됩니다.
ko.The option explains what it will do befo: 시작하기 전에 각 옵션이 무엇을 하는지 설명합니다.
보관 후 삭제 탭에 두 작업이 있습니다.
ko.Archive and delete from the server for s: 선택한 이메일을 서버에서 보관 후 삭제
ko.Archive, back up and delete from the ser: 선택한 이메일을 서버에서 보관, 백업 후 삭제
ko.Archive and delete from the server for a: 설정에서 계정 전체를 서버에서 보관 후 삭제
ko.Archive, back up and delete from the ser: 설정에서 계정 전체를 서버에서 보관, 백업 후 삭제
여기서는 대기 시간을 줄여 보여 줍니다.

zh.Operation Complete, and the Server count: 操作已完成，服务器上的邮件数减少。
zh.The Vault view still holds the archived: Vault 视图中仍保存着已归档的邮件。
服务器视图中不再列出这些邮件。
打开该账户的服务器视图。
邮件批量操作列出各个年份。
zh.Pick a year and see how many emails it s: 挑选一个年份，查看会选中多少封邮件。
zh.The option explains what it will do befo: 开始之前，该选项会说明它将做什么。
阅读确认内容，然后确认。
选择删除的时机和方式。
摘要显示将要移除的内容。
勾选确认项，然后点“开始”。
zh.The job starts and runs in the backgroun: 任务开始，并在后台运行。
进度面板跟踪任务进展。
zh.Archive and delete from the server for s: 从服务器归档并删除选中的邮件
zh.Archive, back up and delete from the ser: 从服务器归档、备份并删除选中的邮件
zh.Archive and delete from the server for a: 在设置中从服务器归档并删除整个账户
zh.Archive, back up and delete from the ser: 在设置中从服务器归档、备份并删除整个账户

pt-br.Progress runs in the corner of the windo: O progresso aparece no canto da janela.
pt-br.Operation Complete, and the Server count: Operação concluída, e a contagem do Servidor diminui.
pt-br.The Vault view still holds the archived: A visão Cofre continua com os e-mails arquivados.
A visão Servidor não os lista mais.
Abra a visão Servidor da conta.
Operações em massa de e-mail lista os anos.
pt-br.Pick a year and see how many emails it s: Selecione um ano e veja quantos e-mails ele seleciona.
pt-br.The option explains what it will do befo: A opção explica o que vai fazer antes de você começar.
Leia a confirmação e depois confirme.
Arquivar e excluir reúne os dois trabalhos.
O resumo mostra o que será removido.
Marque a confirmação e clique em Iniciar.
pt-br.The job starts and runs in the backgroun: O trabalho começa e roda em segundo plano.
O painel de progresso acompanha o trabalho.
pt-br.Archive and delete from the server for s: Arquivar e excluir do servidor os e-mails selecionados
pt-br.Archive, back up and delete from the ser: Arquivar, fazer backup e excluir do servidor os e-mails selecionados
pt-br.Archive and delete from the server for a: Arquivar e excluir do servidor uma conta inteira em Configurações
pt-br.Archive, back up and delete from the ser: Arquivar, fazer backup e excluir do servidor uma conta inteira em Configurações
